column29: Good retake compliance. MTSS referrals are happening. Extension activities are present in some classrooms but not systematically developed as a team practice.
column30: Good instructional consistency. Shared strategies are visible in classrooms. Classwork alignment looks reasonable. Data use to adjust instruction is still developing.
column31: Good team cohesion. Members are prepared and engaged. Formal roles would help with consistency as team membership evolves across school years.
